workload_work_year_days_001.answer: 120 days (minimum required for a year of service)
workload_work_year_days_001.evidence: A year of service for regular, full-time contract teachers shall be a minimum of 120 days of full-time employment within a given school year.

workload_workday_length_002.answer: Seven hours (minimum required for a day of service)
workload_workday_length_002.evidence: A day of service for regular, full-time contract teachers shall be a minimum of seven hours.
